title: One Hive repository registry (v1)
description: Operator-controlled, version-controlled map from repository id to its canonical remotes and publication policy. Credentials MUST NOT be stored here.

fetch_urls.description: Operator-approved URLs for the same git object graph. No userinfo (user:pass@) allowed.

allowed_ref_patterns.description: fnmatch patterns over advertised ref names; a commit is published iff reachable from a ref matching one of these.

local_path.description: Optional local working copy or mirror. Required for mint; verify/materialize can run from the publication cache.
